artifacts.summary: All 5 plan phases complete: skeleton-follow-up reporting (stderr, completion_summary, append-only skeleton_follow_ups state.json field) added to orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's implemented) case, with a new skill-base.sh propagate helper, two new regression fixtures (166 passed/0 failed), and three doc updates.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added report-only skeleton-plan follow-up surfacing to orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh: a strategic-sorry skeleton completion now prints its sorry_inventory follow-ups to stderr, appends them to completion_summary, and records them in an append-only skeleton_follow_ups state.json field, closing the one unaddressed capability loss from the deleted single-task engine without any pr_ready routing or auto-task-creation.

memory_candidates.content: When one new case needs to augment a shared completion/propagation call's argument (e.g. passing an augmented precomputed JSON blob), keep the pre-existing call site as a separate, untouched branch in an if/else rather than merging both cases onto one shared variable feeding a single call. This makes the unaffected case's behavior provably identical by construction (same literal statement, same arguments) rather than merely equal by coincidence of variable assignment, at the cost of a few duplicated lines.

test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's existing fixtures all exercise either the recovery/return-meta path or a deliberately stale/mismatched handoff; none tests the handoff-present (trusted: matching dispatch_seq, fresh mtime) success path for the implemented) case directly. Any new handoff-only field requiring postflight logic (like skeleton/sorry_inventory) needs its own trusted-handoff fixture built from scratch -- write .orchestrator-handoff.json with dispatch_seq matching the --dispatch-seq flag and a window_start a few seconds in the past so the mtime check passes.
